function	script	PN_GradeWorkshopDirectory	{
	mes "[Grade Workshop]";

	.@choice = select("Shadow books and materials:Equipment enchants:Grade enhancement:Refinement:Ore and materials:Healing:Episode progress:Skill supplies:Rune tablet:Damage lab and builds:Main Office:Cancel");

	case 1: navigateto "grademk",22,180; break;
	case 2: navigateto "grademk",26,180; break;
	case 3: navigateto "grademk",32,180; break;

	case 9: navigateto "grademk",44,174; break;
	case 10: navigateto "grademk",44,178; break;
	case 11: navigateto "grademk",20,178; break;
	default: return;
	}
	return;
}
